svg.title: Validation's filter: only the mover and its carrier are ignored
svg.desc: ValidateMoveDestinationAndPath builds the static obstacle filter for the tray move with ignore_trays = {T27} and ignore_agvs = {AGV-7}. Every other tray and AGV in the working state counts, and the destination must be an enabled pose of this filter.
